title: opviewerCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for OP Viewer COMP instances, covering the operator-specific isViewable() recursion-safety query and inherited PanelCOMP / COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs to ask whether an OP Viewer COMP can safely view a target operator without recursion issues.
Pass a path or operator argument to isViewable() before assigning or validating a viewer target that might create a recursive view chain.
Use the exact official docs URL casing OpviewerCOMP_Class; OPViewerCOMP_Class is not the local DocsBrain page URL.
There are no operator-specific members on opviewerCOMP Class; panel values and focus behavior come from inherited PanelCOMP behavior.
